about_the_game:
The Creator Tools is a compilation of various applications and tutorials for people who wish to create their own mods, be it agents, new breeds or even metarooms.

The following applications are included:

  • CAOS Debugger
    The CAOS code debugger lets you browse running agents, inspect their variables and step through code as they run it.
  • CAOS Tool
    This tool is a professional quality tool that allows you to do all things CAOS related.
    It is fully syntax aware and will not allow you to inject anything that is incorrect, but rather than just blindly stopping you it lets you know what the problem is and what was expected.
  • SpriteBuilder
    The SpriteBuilder is the offical Creature Labs sprite handling tool, and was used throughout the creation of Creatures 3 and Docking Station.
  • Map Editor
    The Map Editor is a highly graphical tool that allows you to create new metarooms or alter existing ones.
  • Pose & Gait Editor
    Draws a pretty picture of a Creature and lets you make pose and gait strings.
  • QuickNorn
    Lets you make attachment point files either manually, or from specially colour coded bitmaps.
  • URGEncy
    See what a Norn is doing, and control it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 95/98
  • Processor: Pentium 200 MMX
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: A graphics card with DirectX compatible drivers
  • DirectX: Version 7.0a
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: None required.
